note: The main banks, chosen as the best-known large card issuers (no central bank ranking was read): Bank Islam Brunei Darussalam, Baiduri Bank and Standard Chartered Brunei; only Baiduri Bank's tariffs, already found, were read again this time, for want of the research's budget. Baiduri Bank's general tariffs for personal accounts (rates last updated 15 October 2025), its credit card section, read in full on 2026-10-30 (first read 2026-10-29 for the Visa Classic alone): every Visa and Mastercard credit card is written with its principal card's annual fee (Visa Infinite 380, Platinum 280, Classic 40 Brunei dollars; Smart Executive Platinum free; Royal Brunei Visa Infinite 300 and Visa Platinum 200, each waived for its first 4 years; Mastercard Platinum 280, Classic 40); a financial charge of 1.5% a month on the outstanding balance; a cash advance fee of 3%, at least 10 dollars, plus 1.5% a month from the date of the advance; a late payment fee of 35 dollars a month; an over-limit fee of 15 dollars each time; a returned cheque or payment order fee of 100 dollars; and a 2% fee on foreign currency conversion. The tariff states no minimum payment or grace period. The Visa Classic was first written as 'Visa Credit Classic', the name kept. Wave 4 (2026-10-30): Standard Chartered Brunei is added; Bank Islam Brunei Darussalam's schedule of tariffs (2026 edition, updated 27 August 2026) was read, but its credit cards charge an administration fee of 1.5% a month on the card limit rather than interest on what's carried, which the game's card form doesn't hold, so no BIBD card is written. Standard Chartered Brunei's credit card product disclosure sheet (version 1.0, July 2025, linked from its card pages on 2026-10-30, read that day): the basic card's annual fee, Classic or Standard 45 Brunei dollars, Gold 120, Platinum 268 (waived on 18,000 dollars spent in the twelve months before the fee date), Infinite 688 (waived for good for Priority Banking customers, not written), Hua Ho Mastercard Platinum 120 (waived on 12,000 spent); finance charges 0.049% a day, an effective 18% a year (1.5% a month), written as 1.5% a month, on purchases and cash advances; a cash advance 3%, at least 20 dollars; the minimum payment 8.33% of the principal, at least 40 dollars, plus interest, fees and charges and instalments (written as 8.33% with a 40 floor and the interest added); a late payment 5% of the minimum payment due, at least 25 dollars; a returned direct debit 30 dollars; foreign currency transactions the network's 1% plus a fee of up to 1.7%, written as 2.7%. No interest-free period is stated in figures. Wave 5 (2026-10-30), minimum payments: Baiduri Bank's personal credit card product disclosure sheet (valid as at 16 February 2023, the one its download centre links, read 2026-10-30): within the limit the minimum is 8% of the outstanding balance or 10 dollars, whichever is higher, plus instalments due and any earlier unpaid minimum; written on its eight cards as 8% with a 10 floor.
